mods.name: receipt
mods.description: Adds /receipt: a shareable receipt of the session (tools, files, commands, blocks, context, cost), printed and copied.

mods.name: standup
mods.description: Adds /standup: Yesterday, Today and Blockers from your git log and this session's record, printed and copied.

mods.name: changelog
mods.description: Adds /changelog: commits since the last tag (or the last 30), read with git log and grouped by conventional-commit type, as Markdown.

mods.name: pr-description
mods.description: Adds /pr-description: title, summary, diff totals and a test plan stub for the current branch against main or master, read with git.

mods.name: handoff
mods.description: Adds /handoff: writes a session summary with the git status to .claude/handoff.md (never overwriting) and answers with the path.

mods.name: command-pack
mods.description: Every slash command in one mod: /receipt, /standup, /changelog, /pr-description and /handoff. They read git; /handoff also writes .claude/handoff.md.
